LOOK: Progressive groups gather at the College of Science Library, denouncing the destruction of fishing structures and the ongoing reclamation projects in Manila Bay headed by San Miguel Corporation.

The groups called for the Supreme Court to overturn its decision last year which allowed the operation of commercial fishing vessels in the 15-kilometer municipal waters. Rommel Escarial, president of fisherfolk group PAMALAKAYA-Navotas, claims this intrusion has infringed upon the preferential right of fisherfolk, and the subsequent reclamation has caused flooding to residents in the area.

They also called for the courts to overturn a dismissed petition that sought to restore mussel farms in Navotas. Last year, hundreds of fishing farms in Navotas were dismantled under orders from the local government, depriving fisherfolk communities of their livelihoods.
